title: Elizondo directed AATIP, an offshoot of AAWSAP

tellings.quote: he was the director of atip or the advanced aerial threat identification program which was an offshoot of assab or the advanced Aerospace Weapons Systems application program

plain: A Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo was the director of AATIP, the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, according to Jesse Michels. Michels says this office grew out of AAWSAP, the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program, a larger defense study of the same subject. He gives this as background in his documentary about Elizondo, to show that Elizondo held an official role.
